Strong analytical thinking with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights. Effective communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders across global teams. You can translate complex EQS and business needs into meaningful analytics, challenge assumptions constructively, and design solutions that are both scalable and practical.
